results.trackName: A Night Of Passion With My Best Friend's Mom
results.description:
I've wanted her for as long as I can remember—Sabrina Lawson, my best friend's mom.

She's everything I shouldn't want. Beautiful. Confident. Married. For years, I've stolen glances, imagining what it would be like if she ever looked at me the way I look at her.

The night her son wins the championship, he goes off to celebrate with the team, leaving me alone with her. Just us. One hotel room. One bed.

I told myself nothing would happen. She's off‑limits. She's forbidden.

But then she smiled at me the way I've always dreamed she would. And when she kissed me, I didn't stop her.

That night, we gave in to every unspoken desire. And in the morning, nothing would ever be the same.

A forbidden, age‑gap romance full of slow‑burn tension, aching desire, and one night neither of us will ever forget.
